facts.value: Conceived as the Royal Palace Library by the Nayak kings of Thanjavur (1535-1675); the Maratha rulers (1676-1855) kept it up. Sources differ on the Maratha start: the Wikipedia palace page says the Bhonsle family ruled Tanjore from 1674 to 1855
facts.quote: Conceived and christened as the Royal Palace Library by the Nayak Kings of Thanjavur (1535-1675 AD). And the Maratha rulers (1676-1855) nourished it for intellectual enrichment.
facts.check: curl -sL -A Mozilla/5.0 'https://web.archive.org/web/20110226233412fw_/http://www.sarasvatimahallibrary.tn.nic.in/library/Library_History/body_library_history.html' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -F -o -m1 'Royal Palace Library by the Nayak Kings of Thanjavur'

facts.value: Made a public library in 1918: Government of Madras G.O. Ms. No.1306 Home (Education) dated 5 Oct 1918 took possession under the Charitable Endowment Act; one lakh rupees given for upkeep
facts.quote: took possession of the Library under the Charitable Endowment Act
facts.check: curl -sL -A Mozilla/5.0 'https://web.archive.org/web/20110226233412fw_/http://www.sarasvatimahallibrary.tn.nic.in/library/Library_History/body_library_history.html' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -F -o -m1 'took possession of the Library under the Charitable Endowment Act'
